claim.claim-text: 1. A rotor assembly (60, 360, 460, 560, 860, 960) for a gas turbine engine (20) comprising:

a rotatable hub (62, 362, 462, 562, 662, 762, 862, 962) including a metallic main body (62A, 362A, 562A, 762A, 862A) extending along a longitudinal axis (X), and including an array of annular flanges (62B, 362B, 462B, 562B, 762B, 862B, 962B) extending about an outer periphery (62C, 362C 462C, 562C, 762C) of the main body (62A... 862A) to define an array of annular channels (62D, 362D, 462D, 562D, 762D, 862D) along the longitudinal axis (X); and wherein each of the annular channels (62D... 862D) receives a composite reinforcement member (388, 488, 788, 888) that extends about the outer periphery (62C... 762C) of the hub (62...962).
2. The rotor assembly as recited in claim 1, further comprising:

3. The rotor assembly of claim 1 or 2, wherein the airfoil section (66A... 566A) includes a metallic sheath (72, 172, 272, 472, 572) and a composite core (74, 174, 274, 374, 474), the core (74...474) including first and second ligaments (76A, 76B) at least partially received in respective internal channels (72C, 72D, 172C, 172D) defined in the sheath (72...572).

4. The rotor assembly as recited in any preceding claim, wherein the composite reinforcement member (388, 488, 788, 888) includes at least one composite layer (LL) that extends around the outer periphery (62C... 762C).
5. The rotor assembly as recited in claim 4, wherein the at least one composite layer (LL) is a plurality of composite layers (LL).

6. The rotor assembly as recited in claim 5, wherein the plurality of composite layers (LL) is a carbon tape (389) wound around the outer periphery (62C... 762C) two or more times to define the composite layers (LL).

7. The rotor assembly as recited in any preceding claim, wherein the composite reinforcement member (388, 488, 788, 888) defines a first thickness (T1), and the hub (62... 962) defines a second thickness (T2) along the outer periphery (62C... 762C) that defines a respective one of the annular channels (62D...862D), and the second thickness (T2) is less than the first thickness (T1).

8. The rotor assembly as recited in any preceding claim, wherein each of the annular flanges (62B...962B) is defined by a plurality of scallops (762F) arranged in a respective row (762F-1, 762F-2, 762F-3, 762F-4, 762F-5, 762F-6) about the outer periphery (62C... 762C) of the hub (62... 962).

10. The gas turbine engine as recited in claim 9, wherein each one of the ligaments (76A, 76B) includes at least one interface portion (78, 178, 278) in the root section (66B... 566B) that receives a respective one of the retention pins (68... 968), and each one of the ligaments (76A, 76B) includes at least one composite layer (80) that loops around the at least one interface portion (78, 178, 278) such that opposed end portions (80A, 80B) of the at least one composite layer (80) are joined together along the airfoil section (66A... 566A).

11. The gas turbine engine as recited in claim 9 or 10, wherein each of the annular flanges (62B...962B) includes an array of retention members (590, 690), and each of the retention members (590, 690) is integrally formed with and extends outwardly from a respective one of the annular flanges (62B... 962B) and has an L-shaped geometry defining a contact surface (590D, 690D) that is dimensioned to abut against a sidewall of the airfoil section (66A... 566A) of a respective one of the airfoils (66...566).

12. The gas turbine engine as recited in any of claims 9 to 11, wherein the at least one bearing assembly (38, 438) is positioned radially outward of the outer periphery (62C... 762C) of the hub (62... 962) with respect to the engine longitudinal axis (X).

13. The gas turbine engine as recited in any of claims 9 to 12, further comprising a fan drive turbine that drives the fan shaft (64, 464) through a geared architecture (48, 448), wherein the at least one bearing assembly (38, 438) supports the fan shaft (64, 464) at a position that is radially outward of the geared architecture (48, 448) with respect to the engine longitudinal axis (X).

14. The gas turbine engine as recited in any of claims 9 to 13, wherein the fan section (22, 422) delivers a portion of airflow into a compressor section (24, 424) and another portion of airflow into a bypass duct (443).
